ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I chose Willet because this is a deterministic, computation-heavy finance problem where accuracy matters most. Willet outscores Lapwing across the capability benchmarks most relevant to multi-step quantitative reasoning (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2), so it's the stronger pick for getting the dividend-discount calculation right. Task-preference profiles weren't a deciding factor here since neither model's preferences bear on output quality.
